convert_grid_reference.description: Convert a British National Grid (OSGB36) easting and northing, as used by Ordnance Survey and many UK datasets, to a WGS84 (GPS) latitude and longitude for maps and other apps. No API key required.
convert_grid_reference.display_name: Convert grid reference to latitude and longitude
convert_grid_reference.display_str_template: Convert easting {0}, northing {1} to latitude and longitude.
convert_grid_reference.name: convert_grid_reference

parameters.description: Metres east of the grid's origin, 0 to 700,000. Decimals are rounded to the nearest metre.
parameters.name: easting

parameters.description: Metres north of the grid's origin, 0 to 1,300,000. Decimals are rounded to the nearest metre.
parameters.name: northing

easting.description: The easting that was converted, in whole metres, e.g. 529090.

northing.description: The northing that was converted, in whole metres, e.g. 179645.

summary.description: One line with the conversion, e.g. 'Easting 529090, northing 179645 is latitude 51.50101, longitude -0.14158'.

look_up_postcode.description: Look up an English, Scottish or Welsh postcode in Open Postcode Geo and get its latitude and longitude, grid reference, country, whether it is still in use, and its area, district, sector, outcode and incode. A postcode sector ('SW1A 1'), district ('SW1A') or area ('SW') works too. Unknown postcodes come back with 'found' set to false. No API key required.

mock_response.summary: SW1A 1AA is a live postcode in England (51.501009, -0.141588)

look_up_postcode.name: look_up_postcode

parameters.description: A UK postcode such as 'SW1A 1AA' (any spacing or case), or a postcode sector, district or area. Northern Irish postcodes are not included.
parameters.name: postcode

attribution.description: The copyright statements Open Postcode Geo's licence asks you to show wherever you use the data.

easting.description: The British National Grid easting of the centre, in metres.

found.description: True when Open Postcode Geo holds it. False for an unknown postcode and for every Northern Irish one (its licence excludes them); 'message' then says why.

incode.description: The part after the space, e.g. '1AA'.

latitude.description: The latitude of the postcode's centre, e.g. 51.501009.

longitude.description: The longitude of the postcode's centre, e.g. -0.141588.

match_type.description: What matched: 'unit_postcode' (a full postcode), 'postcode_sector', 'postcode_district' or 'postcode_area'. Only a full postcode has coordinates.

message.description: Why nothing matched, e.g. 'No matching postcode found.'. Empty when found.

northing.description: The British National Grid northing of the centre, in metres.

outcode.description: The part before the space, e.g. 'SW1A'.

positional_quality.description: How precise the location is, from 1 (within the building of a matched address) to 9 (no location available).

postcode_area.description: The postcode area, its first one or two letters, e.g. 'SW'.

postcode_no_space.description: The postcode without its space, e.g. 'SW1A1AA'.

query.description: What was looked up, tidied, e.g. 'SW1A 1AA'.

status.description: 'live', or 'terminated' for a postcode no longer in use.

summary.description: One line about the match, e.g. 'SW1A 1AA is a live postcode in England (51.501009, -0.141588)', or why nothing matched.

usertype.description: 'small' for an ordinary postcode, or 'large' for one given to a single big mail recipient (which may not be at that location).

description: Work with UK locations using GetTheData's free APIs: convert a British National Grid easting and northing to latitude and longitude, and look up English, Scottish and Welsh postcodes for their coordinates and parts. No account or API key required.
